banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round nine, the sixth rules promotion batch under the R968 format: five records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issues 11 and 12 complete (brw the Kuntz brawling opener and bfx its box closer, ilv the Ovalle illusions opener, myt the Persian Mythos opener, fcl the box closer), 253 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides the raised ceiling (Curtiss, 2026-10-31): whole issue groups per round - this batch is 76688 bytes of Lua. Cumulative 35 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 44 remaining.
